;Law and crime
*[[Amir Mirza Hekmati]] is sentenced to death by [[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Revolutionary Court]]. [http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052970204124204577150093452170330.html (''Wall Street Journal'')]

;Politics
*The [[Scottish Government]] announces that it plans to hold the [[2014 Scottish independence referendum|referendum on Scottish independence]] in the autumn of 2014, but [[Secretary of State for Scotland]] [[Michael Moore (British politician)|Michael Moore]] tells the [[House of Commons (United Kingdom)|House of Commons]] that the power to hold a referendum is "reserved" to [[Government of the United Kingdom|Westminster]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-16478121 (BBC)]
*[[Secretary of State for Transport]] [[Justine Greening]] gives the go-ahead for [[HS2]], a £33bn high-speed rail line that will eventually link several major cities in the [[United Kingdom]] to [[London]] and enabling quicker journey times. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-16494354 (BBC)]
*Early reports show that [[Mitt Romney]] wins the [[New Hampshire Republican primary, 2012|New Hampshire Republican primary]] with [[Ron Paul]] in second and [[Jon Huntsman Jr.|Jon Huntsman]] in third. [http://www.cnn.com/2012/01/10/politics/new-hampshire-main/index.html?hpt=hp_t1 (CNN)]
